variants.text: Barred from inside, under nine feet of ash, in a village with no bodies in it. Somebody owns this ground on paper and has never dug — that deed says who was here.
The bar is on the inside and the house is empty. Both of those can be true and neither of them should be.
Warm a foot down, and the rest of the Ashfall cold as stone. Whatever is under here has not finished.
